items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: I had George Gayno on, uh, who was a wonderful talker. I used to transcribe his lessons. About a dozen of his lessons, probably, on banjo.

ctx.x: And this is on the New Orleans Ensemble Stock.

Yeah, it must be, uh, these, uh, I had George Gayno on, uh, who was a wonderful talker. I used to transcribe his lessons. About a dozen of his lessons, probably, on banjo. Then I got started, uh, back in the fifties, recording Mineta. He would teach all instruments. And, uh, still I have a chapter. I had Irvin Helfer, a young pianist from Chicago, recorded a lesson or two of his on piano. I would have a chapter by Mineta on the piano in the band, I guess, as they called it. That was another Otis Ferguson article…
